create_GraphModule: create a GraphModule from a PyTorch nn.Module and an fx.Graph for symbolic tracing
build_GraphModule_recompile: build and recompile a GraphModule after editing its graph to regenerate forward code
export_GraphModule_to_folder: export a GraphModule to a folder with generated Python code and state dict for import
add_GraphModule_submodule: add a submodule to a GraphModule using a fully-qualified target name
delete_GraphModule_unused_submodules: delete all unused submodules from a GraphModule to clean up the module hierarchy
